{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue"}
